item.title: Trump claims U.S. has 'total control' over Strait of Hormuz
item.description: President Trump stated on Wednesday that the U.S. has 'total control' over the Strait of Hormuz, adding 'I THINK WE WILL KEEP IT.'

item.title: Iran live updates: Araghchi says US 'miscalculated' due to intel 'failures'
item.description: President Trump announced "major combat operations" against Iran on Feb. 28, with massive joint U.S.-Israeli strikes.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy sobs loudly, says "I can't do it" during trial testimony
item.description: Lindsay Clancy's murder trial was paused multiple times Wednesday afternoon as she sobbed loudly and said "I can't do it" during testimony.

item.title: Mission Improbable: Ex-Republican aims to prove Democrats can win in Florida
item.description: David Jolly, a former Republican now running for Florida governor as a Democrat, is trying to revive the state's political battleground status
